claude_proposed_widenings.name: SkillFilter.build_time_choice
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: SkillFilter.choice is documented and designed for per-activation cast-time choices (Guidance: 'you choose a skill at cast time'). Scholar's skill selection is a permanent build-time decision made once when the feature is acquired. A timing discriminant or a distinct 'build_time_choice' variant is needed to represent this correctly without semantic leakage into per-activation choice logic.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Choose one of the following skills in which you have proficiency: Arcana, History, Investigation, Medicine, Nature, or Religion. You have Expertise in the chosen skill.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ProficiencyFilter prerequisite
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The SRD requires the chosen skill to be one 'in which you have proficiency.' The current surface has no mechanism to express a prerequisite constraint limiting build-time choices to skills the character already has proficiency in. The 6-option list is encoded, but the proficiency pre-requirement is omitted.
